programme.title: Seo BBC ALBA. This is BBC ALBA
programme.desc: Sealladh ùr bho Alba. A new view from Scotland.

programme.title: Abadas
programme.desc: Tha Hari air mìlsean bhlasta a bhèiceadh airson Ela agus Seren - cèic teòclaid! Bidh aon Abadas air a thaghadh airson a dhol a shealltainn airson rudeigin eile cruinn agus milis. Dè bhios ann? Hari has prepared a yummy treat for Ela and Seren - a chocolate cake! One Abadas will be chosen to go on another exciting adventure looking for something round and sweet-smelling. What could it be?

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Bidh Latha na Cloinne ann a dh’aithghearr agus tha Peicein is a charaidean a’ cur romhpa tuairmsean a thoirt dham pàrantan a thaobh na preusantan a tha iad ag iarraidh. Ged nach eil iad a’ faighinn na bha iad ag iarraidh, tha iad ag iomlaid nam preusantan aca le chèile, is aig deireadh an latha tha iad a’ faighinn na bha iad ag iarraidh. Children’s Day is approaching, so Petit and his friends decide to give their parents clues on what gifts they want. Even though the youngsters don't receive their exact wishes, they end up exchanging presents to get what they all wanted.

programme.title: Pompon Am Mathan Beag/Pompon Little Bear
programme.desc: Gus nach tachair an aon rud a-màireach, ithidh Pompon biadh “glan” gus nach bi aige ri fhiaclan a ghlanadh. Ach a' cheist mhòr: a bheil a leithid a rud ann ri biadh glan? Pompon missed the sun rising as he had to clean his teeth. To avoid the same happening tomorrow, Pompon decides to eat 'clean' food so as to avoid brushing his teeth. But is there such a thing as 'clean' food?

programme.title: Cleasan Ataidh & Tilidh/The Adventures of Abney & Teal
programme.desc: ’S e latha air leth fliuch a th’ ann, is tha Àtaidh a’ lorg toll ann am mullach an taighe. An uair sin tha e a’ mothachadh gu bheil tuill ann an tòrr rudan san taigh aige. Tha e a’ co-dhùnadh toll a chladhach dha fhèin, ach tha e a' steigeadh ann! Ciamar a gheibh Tilidh, Nìp agus na Boga-bogadaich às e? It is a very rainy day and Abney finds a hole in his roof. Then he starts to notice holes everywhere. He decides to dig one of his own but gets stuck in it! How will Teal, Neep and the Poc-Pocs get him out?

programme.title: Sionnach agus Maigheach (Fox & Hare)
programme.desc: Tha Maigheach, Sionnach, Comhachag agus Tosg a’ faighinn cuireadh gu geama croquet còmhla ri Feòrag. Cò tha a’ nochdadh gun fhiathachadh ach Seoc! Chan eil diù aige do riaghailtean agus tha e a’ milleadh a’ ghnothaich air càch. Dìreach mus fheum iad uile sguir a chluich tha Maigheach a’ cur car anns na riaghailtean agus a’ toirt a chreidsinn air Seoc gu bheil e ri cealgaireachd an uair a tha e ann an dha-rìribh a’ cluich a’ gheama dìreach mar bu chòir. Brush invites Hare, Fox, Owl and Tusk for a fancy game of croquet. Jack shows up uninvited and wants to play, too. But being a villain, he can’t stand rules and ruins the game for everyone. Just at the moment the friends are about to give up, Hare reverses the rules to make Jack think he’s cheating but in fact he’s playing the game perfectly.

programme.title: SpongeBob
programme.desc: Tha Mgr. Crùbag a’ cur Laraidh os cionn an taigh-bìdh rè ùine. Mr Krabs makes Larry the Lobster temporary manager.

programme.title: An Sgoil
programme.desc: Latha eile aig Sgoil Taobh na Cloiche agus tha Mrs NicArtair air tàlant ùr a lorg sa chlas ealain aice. Chan eil an Tidsear Stiùiridh, Mgr Hobson, cinnteach gur e tàlant a th’ air cùlaibh na h-ealaine ach ma dh'fhaoidte trioblaid! Aig an aon àm, tha Mgr Mackle a’ dèanamh oidhirp a bhith nas fhallaine. Mrs MacArthur has unearthed a new talent in her art class. Mr Hobson is not so sure if it is talent or perhaps a more troubling issue that’s behind the artwork. Meanwhile, Mr Mackle is busy with a new health kick.

programme.title: Alba Eagalach
programme.desc: Tha sgioba CBBC ALBA a’ toirt thugainn cuid de na sgeulachdan agus na tachartasan as eagalaiche ann an eachdraidh na h-Alba. Anns a’ phrògram seo, gheibh sinn a-mach mu chuid de na nithean neònach os-nàdarrach a tha tric a’ nochdadh ann am beul-aithris le teintean-biorach, caointichean agus tàcharain nam measg. The CBBC ALBA team brings us some of the scariest stories in Scottish history. In this episode, we delve into the paranormal with some of the strangest phenomena in Scottish folklore, including the will-o'-the-wisp, wailing women and changelings.

programme.title: Belle and Sebastian
programme.desc: Nuair tha taisbeanadh sgoile ri obrachadh air thairis air na saor-laithean – mu bheathaichean sgìreil, tron gheamhradh – tha Camshron ‘son na comharran às àird’ sa chlas fhaighinn, agus, mar as àbhaist, tha e ri foill! When there’s a school presentation to work on in the holidays, about regional animals during winter, Cameron wants the highest marks in the class and, as usual, he cheats!

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Faodail: Beatha nan Eilean (Shorts)
programme.desc: Footage from the Faodail | Found Film Archive of the Outer Hebrides from the 1930s to the 1980s, charting growing up in the islands. The strong community ties of past generations still influence the islands today. Filmichean bho Thasglann Faodail | Found Innse Gall bho na 1930an gu na 1980an, a’ clàradh mar a bhathar a’ fàs suas sna h-eileanan. Tha ceanglaichean coimhearsnachd làidir nan ginealaichean a dh’fhalbh fhathast a’ toirt buaidh air na h-eileanan an-diugh. In Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Somhairle Spins
programme.desc: Tha slighe dùbhlanach aig Somhairle agus a bhràthair Innes air a’ chiad latha aca a’ rothaireachd eadar Inbhir Nis agus Glaschu air an Badger Divide. Somhairle and his brother Innes have a challenging start on their first day cycling between Inverness and Glasgow on the Badger Divide.

programme.title: Skipinnish Aig A' Chaisteal
programme.desc: Skipinnish le Alive ann an cuideachd na mìltean de luchd-leantainn aig cuirm-chiùil a’ comharrachadh 25 bliadhna de Skipinnish, bho Chaisteal Dhùn Èideann. Skipinnish perform Alive in front of thousands of fans at a concert celebrating 25 years of the band, from Edinburgh Castle.

programme.title: Mas Fhior
programme.desc: Farpais-cheist do-chreidsinneach... Mas Fhìor! Le ochdnar Mas Fhìoraich a’ cluich bhon dachaighean fhèin, ’s iad an fheadhainn a chuireas na ceistean agus na freagairtean. An urrainn do Kerrie is Ceitidh agus Beniamin is Calum a tha a’ cluich bhon stiùideo, a’ chùis a dhèanamh orra airson an duais mhòr a bhuannachadh? A quiz show that is pretty unbelievable! Eight pretenders play from the comfort of their own homes and hold all the questions and answers to this quiz. Can Kerry and Katie, with Benjamin and Calum in the studio, beat the Pretenders for a chance to win a cash prize? In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Orain Oir
programme.desc: Taghadh às na tasglainn - seinneadairean Gàidhlig tro na bliadhnaichean. Archive performances of Gaelic song, through the decades.

programme.title: Bus Ghlaschu/Glasgow Bus
programme.desc: Thig còmhla ri Packie Bonner, an seann glèidheadair aig Celtic, air ais air Bus Ghlaschu. Follow ex-Celtic goalkeeper Packie Bonner as he relives his journeys on the Glasgow bus.

programme.title: Dàna | Scotland's Wild Side
programme.desc: Suidhichte taobh a-staigh Cearcall na h-Artaig, tha Eileanan Lofoten ann an Nirribhidh a’ tabhann luach fad-beatha de thoileachas don luchd-turais a bhitheas a’ tadhal ann. Air a tharraing leis an t-sreap agus an surfadh air leth a tha ri fhaotainn ann, tha Coinneach MacFhraing a’ siubhal timcheall nan eilean còmhla ri a chompanach, Calum Gibb, gus eòlas fhaighinn air an t-àite miorbhaileach seo. Situated within the Arctic Circle, Norway’s Lofoten islands offer a lifetime’s worth of exploration in the outdoors. Attracted by the world-class climbing and surfing on offer, Coinneach Rankin journeys around the islands with his companion, Calum Gibb, to glean unique experiences.

programme.title: Greim-Bìdh le Gregor
programme.desc: Gregor MacLeod takes fresh langoustines from a local fisherman to make paella, plus raspberry jam from an honesty box is used in a roly-poly.

programme.title: Seirm
programme.desc: Prògram de cheòl traidiseanta agus freumhach air a lìbhrigeadh le Màiri Anna NicUalraig. Air fhilmeadh aig àm Celtic Connections 2024 le clàraidhean is còmhraidhean a chaidh a dhèanamh a dh’aona ghothach airson Seirm, chìte cuid den luchd-ciùil a b’ fheàrr a bha aig an fhèis, leithid Genticorum, Pine Tree Flyers, Kathryn Tickell & The Darkening, Tim O’Brien & Jan Fabricius is Ceitidh Nicphàrlain. Traditional and roots music show presented by Mary Ann Kennedy. Filmed during Celtic Connections 2024, Seirm showcases bespoke recordings and conversations with some of the best artists appearing at the festival. This episode features performances from Genticorum, Pine Tree Flyers, Kathryn Tickell & The Darkening, Tim O’Brien & Jan Fabricius and Katie Macfarlane. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Ro Thrath don t-Saoghal/Born too Soon
programme.desc: Tha Daisy a’ faighinn leigheas èiginneach agus i a’ strì ri a h-anail a tharraing, fhad ’s a tha Treasa agus Ian a’ cur fàilte air na leth-aoin aca agus gan ullachadh fhèin airson Joshua a chall. Tha piseach a’ tighinn air Diane, agus thèid Méabh a ghluasad nas fhaisge air a dachaigh. Daisy receives emergency treatment for severe breathing problems, while Treasa and Ian welcome their twins and prepare to lose Joshua. Diane makes progress, and Méabh is transferred closer to home. Dubbed in Gaelic with English subtitles.

programme.title: Fraochy Bay
programme.desc: Tha stèisean tele eadar-lìon Fraochy Bay a' toirt duais do dh'aona dhuine bochd is iad a' leasachadh an taigh aige, gun fhiosta dha. Ach de a bhios a' feitheamh air Walter McSwain nuair a thilleas e dhachaidh? Fraochy Bay WebTV are doing it themselves. But will the lucky recipient Walter McSwain feel at home when it's time for the big reveal?

programme.title: Abigail
programme.desc: Tha trèat sònraicht' aig Abigail, trèat ùr agus blasta de Fhritearan Mearag-bheag agus Peasair. Fèir ceart 'son a bhith air bòrd lòin air no bòrd bruinse, nuair a tha an teaghlach no caraidean ri tadhal. Abigail has a special treat in store in the form of fresh and tasty courgette and pea fritters. It's perfect for adding to that table top brunch or lunch spread when family or friends are visiting. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Tannadice '87
programme.desc: Tha 2017 a' comharrachadh an 30mh ceann-bliadhna bho rinn Dundee United FC rud a bha mòran dhaoine a' smaointinn a bha do-dheànta dhaibh: faighinn gu cuairt dheireannach Cupa UEFA. Tha Tannadice87 ag innse sgeulachd iongantach an iomairt Eòrpaich sin, bliadhna san do theab Dundè, a tha ainmeil airson silidh, diut agus naidheachdas, clach eile a chur air càrn urraim a' bhaile. 2017 marks the 30th anniversary of the year that Dundee United FC delivered on what many believed to be an impossible goal; reaching the final of the UEFA Cup. Tannadice '87 tells the remarkable story of this European adventure, a year in which dreams became reality, and Dundee, a city with a reputation for jam, jute and journalism added a fourth 'j' to its trademark: jubilation.

programme.title: Belladrum
programme.desc: Plòigh na fèise ann an cuideachd Nile Rodgers & Chic agus iad a’ toirt ceòl disco is pop chun na Gàidhealtachd air Disathairne aig Belladrum 2022. A’ chuid as fheàrr den fhèis le Fiona NicChoinnich agus Niall Iain Dòmhnallach. All the fun of the festival from funk stars, Nile Rodgers & Chic. The musical heroes bring disco and pop to the Highlands as they rock the stage on Saturday at Belladrum, 2022. Fiona MacKenzie and Niall Iain Macdonald present the best of the festival.

programme.title: Somhairle Spins
programme.desc: Tha Somhairle agus a charaidean bho’n oilthigh a’ deanamh air an t-slighe baidhsagal ainmeil Na Còig Aiseagan, le measgachadh spòrsail de dh’eòlasan, casan sgìth agus tòinean goirt! Somhairle and his university friends take on the infamous Five Ferries cycle route, with an entertaining mix of experience, resulting in tired legs and sore backsides!

programme.title: Somhairle Spins
programme.desc: Tha slighe dùbhlanach aig Somhairle agus a bhràthair Innes air a’ chiad latha aca a’ rothaireachd eadar Inbhir Nis agus Glaschu air an Badger Divide. Somhairle and his brother Innes have a challenging start on their first day cycling between Inverness and Glasgow on the Badger Divide.

programme.title: Somhairle Spins
programme.desc: Às dèidh toiseach tòiseachaidh dùbhlanach, lean Somhairle agus Innes orra a’ rothaireachd air a Bhadger Divide, far an tàinig iad tarsainn air duilgheadasan meacanaigeach; uisge trom; geàrr-rathaidean; tionndadh ceàrr agus bagannan caillte! Thàinig an rothaiche agus an neach-gleidhidh chlàran, Kerry Nic a’Phì, còmhla riutha airson earrann. After a tough start, Somhairle and Innes continue riding the Badger Divide, where they encounter mechanical issues, torrential rain, shortcuts, wrong turns and lost baggage! They’re joined for a section by record-holder, cyclist Kerry MacPhee.

programme.title: Serie A (BBC Alba)
programme.desc: Ball-coise beò bho Serie A le Sassuolo a’ cur fàilte air Napoli. An geama slàn ri fhaicinn le Ailig O’ Henley a’ preasantadh bho oir na pàirce agus aithris bho Micheal Steele. Football action from Serie A as Sassuolo welcome Napoli. Presented pitchside with Alex O’ Henley, while commentary comes from Micheal Steele.

programme.title: Losgannan | Froglets
programme.desc: Tha Sif, Pipp agus Bran a’ dol a chladhach airson ionmhais àrsaidh san t-sloc-gainmhich. Ziff, Pipp and Button set out to unearth ancient treasures buried in the garden sandpit.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Feumaidh an Dùd Beag a bhith far an urrainn dha bhith dùdach fad’ an là. Gu mì-fhortanach, chaidh e air seachran ach fhuair e a shlighe dhachaidh gu Planaid nan Dùd, le beagan taic bho a charaidean ùra Little Dùd needs to be where he can hoot all day. Unfortunately, he goes missing but finds his way back home to Planet Dùd, with a little help from his new friends.

programme.title: Na Clangairean
programme.desc: Tha dùbhradh grèine ann an-diugh ach, gu mì-fhortanach, tha a’ Chearc Iarainn a’ dùbhradh an dùbhradh. Ciamar a gheibh iad air seo a rèiteachadh? There’s a solar eclipse happening today but, unfortunately, the Iron Chicken is eclipsing the event. How will they resolve this?

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha Mossy air bhioran gus a charaid ùr, Fred, a thoirt gu cruinneachaidh-cluich an sgioba. Ge-tà ‘s e deargann a th’ ann am Fred ‘s chan eil càch cho toilichte a leithid fhaicinn nam measg... gus an seall Fred g’ eil e feumail na dhòigh fhèin! Mossy is excited to bring his new friend, Fred, to today’s playdate, but the rest of the gang are less than enamoured when they learn that Fred is actually a flea! However, Fred soon shows that he is quite useful to have around!

programme.title: Creag nam Buthaidean/Puffin Rock
programme.desc: Tha bràmair aig Bernie ‘s tha i gus tighinn gu dìnnear a-nochd! Ge-tà, chan eil dad a dh'fhios aig Bernie dè chuireas e air dòigh! Tha Oona ‘s Baba ag aontachadh a chuideachadh ach, le Mossy nam meag, saoil am bi biadh air fhàgail mus nochd i? Bernie has a girlfriend – and she’s on her way to the grotto for dinner! However, Bernie has no idea what to prepare for her! Oona and Baba agree to help him out but, with Mossy joining the fray, will there be any food left for the special guest?

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Bing agus a charaidean a’ tarraing dealbh do Gilly, tha Teàrlaidh a' cur sgròb mhòr air feadh an deilbh aige-san ach tha Gilly a sealltainn dhaibh nach b' e droch rud a bh’ ann. When Bing and his friends draw a picture for Gilly, Charlie does a squiggle on Bing’s picture. But Gilly shows them that this is not such a bad thing.

programme.title: Bing
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Bing aig taigh Sula ’son Pàrtaidh Aodach-oichdh’, tha e a' gabhail feagal nuair a tha e a' cluinntinn meanglan mòr, sgrìobach bho muigh. Ach, an uairsin, tha e ag ionnsachadh nach eil rudan eagallach cho eagallach sa shaoileas tu. When Bing is at Sula’s house for a PJ Party, he gets frightened when he hears a large scratchy branch outside. At the end of the day though, he learns that things aren’t as scary as you think they are.

programme.title: Peicein/Petit
programme.desc: Tha Peicein a’ fiathachadh a charaidean gu àite-obrach athar. Ach chan eil Dadaidh Pheicein a’ leigeil leotha suathadh ann an dad ach an t-ùrlar, is tha sin a’ fàs dòrainneach. Mu dheireadh thall, tha Dadaidh Pheicein a’ sealltainn dhaibh gun urrainn saorsainneachd a bhith air leth spòrsail. Petit invites his friends to his dad's workplace. But his dad won't let them touch anything except the floor and they start to get really bored. Finally, Petit's dad shows them how carpentry can be lots of fun.

programme.title: Hilda
programme.desc: Tha rudeigin dìomhair mun nighean ùr a th’ air an t-sràid – agus dè an gnothach a th’ aice ri trom-laighe Dhaibhidh? Tha Hilda airson a chuideachadh gus am faigh e seachad air an eagal a th’ air aig àm cadail. There is something mysterious about the new girl on the street. And what does she have to do with Daibhidh’s nightmares? Hilda wants to help him get over his fear of night time.

programme.title: Geamaichean Gorach
programme.desc: Tha Olaidh agus Coinneach ann an Ruisia agus chan e dìreach sgìtheadh a tha a’ gabhail àite oir tha sinn a’ faicinn tanca, saighdearan a’ caismeachd agus…. geama leigeil-shaighdear? Olaidh and Coinneach are in Russia but skiing isn’t the only thing that’s going on - there’s a tank to be seen, soldiers marching and....a game of skittles?

programme.title: Geamaichean Gorach
programme.desc: Nuair a tha Coinneach Clogaid a’ feuchainn ri brath fhaighinn air an fheadhainn eile, le bhith a’ cur an eagail orra leis a’ chruthachadh ‘eagallach’ aige, chan eil cùisean idir a’ dol leis. When Coinneach Clogaid tries to take advantage of the others by trying to frighten them with his 'scary' creation, things don’t quite go to plan.

programme.title: Flix
programme.desc: Tha pàrantan Munchkin air earbs’ a chur ann, an cafaidh aca a ruith ’son a’ chiad turas, is chan eil e ’son fàiligeadh. Ri linn sin, tha Tabaidh is Flix ‘son a chuideachadh le obair-frithealaidh – ach saoil am bith iad feumail dha? Munchkin’s parents put their faith in him to run their cafe for the first time, and he doesn’t want to fail. As a result, Tabaidh and Flix want to help with serving, but will they be of any use?

programme.title: A-null ’s a-nall
programme.desc: Tha Denis 10 bliadhna a dh'aois. Tha fadachd mhòr air gus am bi e cheart cho comasach is fèillmhor ri a bhràthair mòr, Marcus. Ge-tà, le beagan oidhirp’, tha Denis a’ sealltainn dhaibh uile g’ eil e cheart cho tàlantach, na dhòigh fhèin! Denis is ten years old. He is desperate to be as capable and popular as his older brother, Marcus. However, with a bit of effort, Denis shows everyone that he is equally talented, in his own way!

programme.title: An Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach là cuide ri fiosrachadh coimhearsnachd bho BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news and information from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Seachd Là
programme.desc: Naidheachdan ionadail, nàiseanta is eadar-nàiseanta gach seachdainn le sgioba-naidheachd BBC ALBA. Local, national and international news from BBC ALBA.

programme.title: Alleluia!
programme.desc: Salm 72 air a sheinn le Kathleen Ghreumach, Criosda a-mhàin le Calum Ailig Mac a' Mhaolain, bidh Criosaidh Màiri NicNèill ag innse mar a tha a creideamh air a bhith na chofhurtachd dhi aig àm trioblaidean teaghlaich, agus bidh Màiri Nic a' Ghobhainn a' leughadh à Ortha nan Gaidheal. Tha am prògram air aithris le Iain MacFhionghain. Kathleen Graham sings Psalm 72, and Calum Alex MacMillan sings Criosda a-mhàin. Chrissie Mary MacNeil tells how her faith has helped her deal with life-threatening illness in the family, and Mary Smith reads from Carmina Gadelica. Presented by Iain MacKinnon.

programme.title: Port An Obain
programme.desc: In the village of Appin, Gregor MacCormick shows his collection of vintage engines, and retired sea captain Eric Smith visits the new lighthouse ship, the Pole Star. Ann a baile Appain tha Gregor MacCormaig a sealltainn na seann einseanean. Agus anns an Obain tha Captein Eric Mac’a Ghobhainn a ceilidh air am Pole Star ura. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Rùm Gu Rùm, Le Erica
programme.desc: Actress, turned interior designer, Erica Macpherson, takes us on a design adventure throughout the Highlands and Islands. With the help of local craft workers she finds new ideas for designing old spaces. Tha an cleasaiche, a tha a-nis na dealbhaiche cruthachail thaighean, Erica Nic a’ Phersain, a’ gabhail sgrìob tron Ghàidhealtachd ‘s na h-Eileanan. Le taic bho luchd-ciùird, tha i a’ lorg dhòighean ùra air seann rumanan a thoirt beò. In Gaelic with English subtitles

programme.title: Duncan Mackenzie - Dileab a' Ghlinne
programme.desc: Dealas stàcair do dhachaigh a shinnsearan ann an Gleann Inbhir Làthail faisg air Ulapul. Local historian and deerstalker Duncan Mackenzie’s passion for Inverlael Glen, near Ullapool.

programme.title: Calum Cille: An Naomh Dana/Columba - The Bold Saint
programme.desc: He was at the centre of a bloody battle and founded a monastery that became a beacon of civilisation in the Early Middle Ages. But who was Colmcille, the Irish abbot also known as St Columba?

programme.title: An Cruinne Caochlaideach/Dynamic Planet
programme.desc: As the ice drastically melts, we see how science, nature and tradition can prepare us for the future.

programme.title: The Crucible: 40 Golden Snooker Years
programme.desc: Steve Davis goes back to the Crucible Theatre in Sheffield to celebrate 40 years of the World Snooker Championship. If the walls of this famous regional theatre could talk, they would tell tales of tears, triumphs, occasional debauchery, laughter and top-class sport. With contributions from snooker legends Dennis Taylor, Stephen Hendry, Jimmy White and super-fans Stephen Fry and Richard Osman.

programme.title: Davis v Taylor: The '85 Black Ball Final
programme.desc: A look back at one of British sport's golden moments - the 1985 World Championship Snooker final. At its peak, over 18 and a half million people sat glued to their sets as Steve Davis and Dennis Taylor battled past midnight to a final and deciding black ball, BBC Two's biggest ever audience. Colin Murray journeys around the UK filling in the gaps on the first time that he was allowed to see the other side of midnight. Along the way he finds answers to questions such as where did Dennis's 'upside-down glasses' actually come from? What really went on behind those dressing room doors? How did you spread the news in a world without mobile phones? And how different would the lives of the two protagonists have been if the result had been reversed that night? Featuring contributions from Barry McGuigan, Ted Lowe, Stephen Hendry and Barry Hearn.

programme.title: Anything Goes: The Musical
programme.desc: Filmed live at the Barbican in London, this major production of the classic musical comedy features an all-star cast led by renowned Broadway actress Sutton Foster, reprising her Tony-winning performance as Reno Sweeney, alongside the award-winning Robert Lindsay and Felicity Kendal, as well as beloved West End legend Gary Wilmot. A heart-warming romance, featuring spectacular dance routines and some of theatre’s most memorable songs. When the SS American heads out to sea, etiquette and convention head out of the portholes as two unlikely pairs set off on the course to true love - proving that sometimes destiny needs a little help from a crew of singing sailors, a comical disguise and some good old-fashioned blackmail. This hilarious musical romp across the Atlantic, directed by the multi-award-winning Broadway director and choreographer Kathleen Marshall, features Cole Porter’s joyful score, including I Get a Kick Out of You, You’re the Top and the show-stopping Anything Goes.

programme.title: Simply Nigella
programme.desc: As Nigella says, 'Part of the balance of life lies in understanding that different days require different types of eating'. So in this episode, Nigella shares her favourite menu to help get that balance in the kitchen. For the days when something light and luscious is needed, Nigella's salad of salmon, avocado, watercress and pumpkin seeds fits perfectly. For the occasions that call for something a bit different, there is Nigella's chicken shawarma with an array of spices, sauces and flatbreads. Inspired by a spit-roasted Lebanese kebab, Nigella's oven-roasted version is fun, tasty and prefect for feeding a crowd. There has to be chocolate in the balance and Nigella shares two of her latest treats - a glossy liquorice and blackcurrant chocolate cake and her chocolate chip cookie dough pots - freshly baked pots of gooey cookie dough served with a dollop of ice cream or creme fraiche.

programme.title: Bargain Hunt
programme.desc: Charlie Ross is in Shropshire, where experts Tim Weeks and Ben Cooper try to help the teams make big profits when they head to the auction in Malvern. programme.desc: Introduced by Kirsty Young. Acquired for the BBC, the princess’s deeply personal film explores life beyond diagnosis and the many ways people find comfort, strength and hope in the face of serious illness. It follows the princess on a journey through some of Britain's most spectacular landscapes as she undertakes the National Three Peaks Challenge, climbing the highest mountains in Scotland, England and Wales, to meet her family at the finish line. Set against the backdrop of the challenge itself, the princess reflects on her own experience alongside individuals navigating their own health journeys. Together, they explore the profound impact serious illness can have on the whole person, and the people, places and experiences that can help us heal.

programme.title: Behind Enemy Lines
programme.desc: A Navy pilot (Owen Wilson) is shot down over enemy territory, and struggles to survive the relentless pursuit of a ruthless secret police enforcer, a deadly tracker, and countless hostile troops. With time running out, the injured pilot's commanding officer (Gene Hackman) goes against orders to carry out a desperate rescue mission.

programme.title: Stop-Loss
programme.desc: His tour of duty in Iraq finally over, Staff Sgt. Brandon King returns home to Brazos, Texas, ready to re-enter civilian life. Unexpectedly, the Army invokes a clause in Brandon's military contract, requiring him to return to active duty in Iraq. With the help of close friend Michele, Brandon goes AWOL and struggles to find a way out of the dilemma.

programme.title: Dunkirk
programme.desc: In May 1940, Germany advanced into France, trapping Allied troops on the beaches of Dunkirk. Under air and ground cover from British and French forces, troops were slowly and methodically evacuated from the beach using every serviceable naval and civilian vessel that could be found. At the end of this heroic mission, 330,000 French, British, Belgian and Dutch soldiers were safely evacuated.

programme.title: Argo
programme.desc: On Nov. 4, 1979, militants storm the U.S. embassy in Tehran, Iran, taking 66 American hostages. Amid the chaos, six Americans manage to slip away and find refuge with the Canadian ambassador. Knowing that it's just a matter of time before the refugees are found and likely executed, the U.S. government calls on extractor Tony Mendez (Ben Affleck) to rescue them. Mendez's plan is to pose as a Hollywood producer scouting locations in Iran and train the refugees to act as his "film" crew.

programme.title: Reindeer Games
programme.desc: Just released from prison, all Rudy Duncan (Ben Affleck) wants is to start a new life with Ashley (Charlize Theron), the girl of his dreams, whom he met through pen pal letters in prison. But between them and happiness stands her crazy brother, Gabriel (Gary Sinise), and his motley crew of deadly criminals who think Rudy has some inside information about a casino where he once had a job -- a casino Gabriel and his short-fused posse plan to take down.

programme.title: Fist Fight
programme.desc: On the last day before summer vacation, high school teacher Andy Campbell tries his best to keep it together amid senior pranks, a dysfunctional administration and budget cuts that threaten his job. Things go from bad to worse when he crosses Ron Strickland, the school's toughest and most feared teacher. When Strickland gets fired, he challenges Campbell to a fight after school. As news of the showdown spreads like wildfire, poor Andy desperately seeks any way out of his date with certain doom.

programme.title: Rush Hour
programme.desc: When a Chinese diplomat's daughter is kidnapped in Los Angeles, he calls in Hong Kong Detective Inspector Lee (Jackie Chan) to assist the FBI with the case. But the FBI doesn't want anything to do with Lee, and they dump him off on the LAPD, who assign wisecracking Detective James Carter (Chris Tucker) to watch over him. Although Lee and Carter can't stand each other, they choose to work together to solve the case on their own when they figure out they've been ditched by both the FBI and police.

programme.title: Rush Hour 2
programme.desc: After an explosion at the US Embassy in Hong Kong kills two customs agents investigating currency smuggling, Inspector Lee (Jackie Chan) and James Carter (Chris Tucker) search for the mastermind. Ricky Tan (John Lone), head of the Fu-Cang-Long Triad, sends out his minions to ensure that Carter and Lee don't solve the case.

programme.title: Rush Hour 3
programme.desc: East meets West when the assassination of Ambassador Han leads to the reunion of Lee and Carter. In Paris, the pair must stay one step ahead of Chinese gangsters and Lee's childhood friend, as they track down an envelope containing the identity of a powerful crime lord.

programme.title: Private Parts
programme.desc: The life and career of shock-jock superstar Howard Stern (himself) is recounted from his humble beginnings to his view from the top. Possessing a desire to be an on-air personality since childhood, Stern meanders through the radio world, always with his supportive wife, Alison (Mary McCormack), by his side. Landing a gig in Washington, D.C., Stern meets Robin Quivers (herself), who will become his long-time partner in crime. When the two move to New York, they face the wrath of NBC executives.

programme.title: Killer Joe
programme.desc: A cop (Matthew McConaughey) who moonlights as a hit man agrees to kill the hated mother of a desperate drug dealer (Emile Hirsch) in exchange for a tumble with the young man's virginal sister (Juno Temple).

programme.title: Domestic Disturbance
programme.desc: Frank Morrison (John Travolta) no longer lives with his ex-wife, Susan (Teri Polo), and 12-year-old son, Danny (Matt O'Leary). Susan and Danny now live with Rick Barnes (Vince Vaughn), Susan's new husband. Danny, who has a reputation for telling lies, has accused his stepfather of committing a murder. But Frank is the only one who believes him. Now the father Danny trusts must protect him from the stepfather he fears.

programme.title: Sleeping Dogs
programme.desc: Suffering from memory loss, a former homicide detective tries to solve a brutal murder that he can't recall. As he pieces together evidence from a decade-old investigation, he soon uncovers a sinister web of buried secrets tied to his forgotten past.

programme.title: Queen of the Damned
programme.desc: Follows the legendary vampire Lestat (Stuart Townsend), who has reinvented himself as a rock star in the contemporary American music scene. His music wakes Akasha (Aaliyah), the queen of all vampires, and inspires her desire to make Lestat her king. Akasha's malevolent power is so great that all the immortal vampires must stand against her if they want to survive. Meanwhile, a young London woman with a fascination for the dark side (Marguerite Moreau) falls in love with Lestat.

programme.title: A Perfect Murder
programme.desc: Wall Street baron Steven Taylor (Michael Douglas) discovers that his pretty young wife, Emily (Gwyneth Paltrow), is cheating on him. But what concerns him more than her infidelity is the hope of profiting from her untimely death. Emily has millions, and Steve's own financial empire is collapsing before his eyes. He hires her lover, David (Viggo Mortensen), to murder her. The plan -- to stage a break-in that will look like a random murder -- turns out to be far from perfect.

programme.title: Shutter Island
programme.desc: The implausible escape of a brilliant murderess brings U.S. Marshal Teddy Daniels and his new partner to Ashecliffe Hospital, a fortress-like insane asylum located on a remote, windswept island. The woman appears to have vanished from a locked room, and there are hints of terrible deeds committed within the hospital walls. As the investigation deepens, Teddy realizes he will have to confront his own dark fears if he hopes to make it off the island alive.

programme.title: Noah
programme.desc: When God decides that mankind has become too sinful and must be wiped off the Earth, he chooses Noah (Russell Crowe), a pious man, for a great task. Noah must build an ark large enough to hold his wife (Jennifer Connelly), adopted daughter (Emma Watson), sons (Logan Lerman, Douglas Booth, Leo McHugh Carroll) and their wives -- plus breeding pairs of every animal. When the task is completed, Noah and his family witness God's wrath in the form of an apocalyptic flood.

programme.title: Sweeney Todd: The Demon Barber of Fleet Street
programme.desc: Evil Judge Turpin (Alan Rickman) lusts for the beautiful wife of a London barber (Johnny Depp) and transports him to Australia for a crime he did not commit. Returning after 15 years and calling himself Sweeney Todd, the now-mad man vows revenge, applying his razor to unlucky customers and shuttling the bodies down to Mrs. Lovett (Helena Bonham Carter), who uses them in her meat-pie shop. Though many fall to his blade, he will not be satisfied until he slits Turpin's throat.

programme.title: Sweetness
programme.desc: When a superfan learns that her rock-star idol is spiraling into addiction, she makes it her mission to save him, whether he wants her help or not. However, when her desperate plan spins out of control, she kidnaps him in a delusional attempt to fix him. What started as compassion soon turns into captivity as she locks him away in the name of love.

programme.title: The Equalizer 2
programme.desc: Robert McCall's mysterious past cuts especially close to home when thugs kill Susan Plummer, his best friend and former colleague. Now out for revenge, McCall must take on a crew of highly trained assassins who'll stop at nothing to destroy him.

programme.title: The Manchurian Candidate
programme.desc: Years after his squad was ambushed during the Gulf War, Major Ben Marco (Denzel Washington) finds himself having terrible nightmares. He begins to doubt that his fellow squad-mate Sergeant Raymond Shaw (Liev Schreiber), now a vice-presidential candidate, is the hero he remembers him being. As Marco's doubts deepen, Shaw's political power grows, and, when Marco finds a mysterious implant embedded in his back, the memory of what really happened begins to return.

programme.title: Enemy at the Gates
programme.desc: Vassili is a young Russian sharpshooter who becomes a legend when a savvy political officer makes him the hero of his propaganda campaign. Their friendship is threatened when both men fall in love with a beautiful female soldier. As the battle for the city rages, Vassili faces the ultimate challenge when the Nazi command dispatches its most elite marksman to hunt down and kill the man who has become the hope of all Russia.

programme.title: Hostage
programme.desc: After one of his hostage negotiations goes awry, LAPD officer Jeff Talley (Bruce Willis) quits the force and relocates his family to the suburbs. As the sheriff in a sleepy town, Jeff thinks he has escaped the hustle and bustle -- until an elaborate local heist puts him back in the center of a hostage situation. When his own family is pulled into the fray, Jeff is forced to decide whether he should try to help the hostages or follow the criminals' hands-off mandate to protect his own family.

programme.title: The Silent Planet
programme.desc: Serving a life sentence alone on a distant planet, an aging convict must confront his past when a new prisoner arrives and forces him to remember his life on Earth.

programme.title: Galaxy Quest
programme.desc: The stars of a 1970s sci-fi show -- now scraping a living through re-runs and sci-fi conventions are beamed aboard an alien spacecraft. Believing the cast's heroic on-screen dramas are historical documents of real-life adventures, the band of aliens turns to the ailing celebrities for help in their quest to overcome the oppressive regime in their solar system.

programme.title: Paycheck
programme.desc: Michael Jennings is a top-notch reverse engineer. Corporations pay him to crack the secrets of their competitors' products. When the job is done, he has his memory of it erased. Rethrick, head of a company called Allcom, hires Jennings to reverse-engineer a secret government device. After the job, Jennings wakes from the memory erasure to find himself being chased by various agencies. He soon realizes that the fate of the entire world may be in his hands.

programme.title: Sleepless
programme.desc: Undercover Las Vegas police officer Vincent Downs (Jamie Foxx) finds himself caught in a high-stakes web of corrupt cops, internal affairs and murderous gangsters. When a failed heist leads to the kidnapping of his teenage son (Octavius J. Johnson), Downs must race against time during a wild and restless night to save him and bring the criminals to justice.

programme.title: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: In Steven Spielberg's massive blockbuster, paleontologists Alan Grant (Sam Neill) and Ellie Sattler (Laura Dern) and mathematician Ian Malcolm (Jeff Goldblum) are among a select group chosen to tour an island theme park populated by dinosaurs created from prehistoric DNA. While the park's mastermind, billionaire John Hammond (Richard Attenborough), assures everyone that the facility is safe, they find out otherwise when various ferocious predators break free and go on the hunt.

programme.title: The Lost World: Jurassic Park
programme.desc: Four years after "Jurassic Park," mathematician Ian Malcolm ventures onto a second island to save his girlfriend from becoming dinosaur bait.

programme.title: Jurassic Park III
programme.desc: After being persuaded by a wealthy businessman to conduct an aerial tour of Isla Sorna, InGen's second site for a failed Jurassic Park experiment, Dr. Alan Grant discovers the true reason for his invitation. A tragic accident maroons the party of seven, and they must attempt to escape with their lives.

programme.title: A Mermaid's Tale
programme.desc: Twelve-year-old Ryan is despondent about moving to a dying seacoast village until she forms an unlikely friendship with a quirky teenage mermaid.

programme.title: The Legend of Catclaws Mountain
programme.desc: Mindy adopts Angel, a high-spirited pony that according to legend will lead its owner to gold hidden in the nearby mountains. When Angel is kidnapped by a mad treasure hunter, Mindy and her school friends head into the hills to rescue the pony and hunt for the lost gold.

programme.title: Jurassic Park

When he learns of Carl's betrayal, Sam must seek the help of psychic Oda Mae Brown (Whoopi Goldberg) to set things right and protect Molly from Carl and his goons.

When terrorism reaches a new level that includes the ability to hack into people's minds and control them, Major is uniquely qualified to stop it. As she prepares to face a new enemy, Major discovers that her life was stolen instead of saved. Now, she will stop at nothing to recover her past while punishing those who did this to her.

At first the horse struggles to win, but eventually Seabiscuit becomes one of the most successful thoroughbreds of all time, and inspires a nation at a time when it needs it most.

programme.title: The Hunt for Red October
programme.desc: Based on the popular Tom Clancy novel, this suspenseful movie tracks Soviet submarine captain Marko Ramius as he abandons his orders and heads for the east coast of the United States. Equipped with innovative stealth technology, Ramius' submarine, "Red October," is virtually invisible. However, when an American sub briefly detects the Russians' presence, CIA agent Jack Ryan sets out to determine Ramius' motives, fearing he may launch an attack on the U.S.

programme.title: The Godfather
programme.desc: Widely regarded as one of the greatest films of all time, this mob drama, based on Mario Puzo's novel of the same name, focuses on the powerful Italian-American crime family of Don Vito Corleone (Marlon Brando). When the don's youngest son, Michael (Al Pacino), reluctantly joins the Mafia, he becomes involved in the inevitable cycle of violence and betrayal. Although Michael tries to maintain a normal relationship with his wife, Kay (Diane Keaton), he is drawn deeper into the family business.

In addition to being re-edited with the new footage, the film has been completely restored, converted to digital, and reprinted by dye-transfer, improving color reproduction.

Somerset also befriends Mills' wife, Tracy (Gwyneth Paltrow), who is pregnant and afraid to raise her child in the crime-riddled city.

When V saves a young woman named Evey from the secret police, he discovers an ally in his fight against England's oppressors.

programme.title: Patriot Games
programme.desc: When former CIA agent Jack Ryan (Harrison Ford) hampers an IRA terrorist attack in London, he kills one of the terrorists. The dead man's brother, another member of the group named Sean Miller (Sean Bean), is arrested but quickly escapes. Vowing revenge against Ryan, Miller travels to the United States, where he forces Ryan's wife (Anne Archer) and daughter (Thora Birch) into a car accident that badly injures them. This convinces Ryan to rejoin the CIA in order to track down Miller.

programme.title: Reindeer Games
programme.desc: Just released from prison, all Rudy Duncan (Ben Affleck) wants is to start a new life with Ashley (Charlize Theron), the girl of his dreams, whom he met through pen pal letters in prison. But between them and happiness stands her crazy brother, Gabriel (Gary Sinise), and his motley crew of deadly criminals who think Rudy has some inside information about a casino where he once had a job -- a casino Gabriel and his short-fused posse plan to take down.

programme.title: Nanny McPhee Returns
programme.desc: Enigmatic Nanny McPhee arrives on the doorstep of a harried mother, Isabel Green, who is trying to raise her kids and tend to the family farm while her husband is away at war. Isabel has her hands full of not only her own three, but also with her sister's spoiled pair. With no time to lose, McPhee uses magic to instill in the children five important lessons.

programme.title: Shazam!
programme.desc: We all have a superhero inside of us -- it just takes a bit of magic to bring it out. In 14-year-old Billy Batson's case, all he needs to do is shout out one word to transform into the adult superhero Shazam. Still a kid at heart, Shazam revels in the new version of himself by doing what any other teen would do -- have fun while testing out his newfound powers. But he'll need to master them quickly before the evil Dr. Thaddeus Sivana can get his hands on Shazam's magical abilities.

programme.title: Shazam! Fury of the Gods
programme.desc: Bestowed with the powers of the gods, Billy Batson and his fellow foster kids are still learning how to juggle teenage life with their adult superhero alter egos. When a vengeful trio of ancient gods arrives on Earth in search of the magic stolen from them long ago, Shazam and his allies get thrust into a battle for their superpowers, their lives, and the fate of the world.

programme.title: Robin Hood
programme.desc: After the death of Richard the Lion-Hearted, a skilled archer named Robin Longstride travels to Nottingham, where villagers suffer under a despotic sheriff and crippling taxation. He meets and falls in love with a spirited widow, Marion, although she is skeptical of his motives. Hoping to win her heart and save the village, Robin gathers a band of warriors to fight corruption in Nottingham, little knowing they will soon be fighting to save England itself.

programme.title: Rampage
programme.desc: Primatologist Davis Okoye shares an unshakable bond with George, an extraordinarily intelligent, silverback gorilla that's been in his care since birth. When a rogue genetic experiment goes wrong, it causes George, a wolf and a reptile to grow to a monstrous size. As the mutated beasts embark on a path of destruction, Okoye teams up with a discredited genetic engineer and the military to secure an antidote and prevent a global catastrophe.

programme.title: Tomb Raider
programme.desc: Lara Croft is the fiercely independent daughter of an eccentric adventurer who vanished years earlier. Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan. The stakes couldn't be higher as Lara must rely on her sharp mind, blind faith and stubborn spirit to venture into the unknown.

programme.title: X-Men: First Class
programme.desc: In the early 1960s, during the height of the Cold War, a mutant named Charles Xavier (James McAvoy) meets a fellow mutant named Erik Lehnsherr (Michael Fassbender). Despite their vastly different backgrounds -- Charles grew up with a wealthy family, while Erik lost his parents at Auschwitz -- the two become close friends. As the world teeters on the brink of a nuclear war, Charles and Erik with other mutants join forces to save humanity. However, a situation soon tears the friends apart.

programme.title: The Alto Knights

programme.desc: Lara Croft is the fiercely independent daughter of an eccentric adventurer who vanished years earlier. Hoping to solve the mystery of her father's disappearance, Croft embarks on a perilous journey to his last-known destination -- a fabled tomb on a mythical island that might be somewhere off the coast of Japan. The stakes couldn't be higher as Lara must rely on her sharp mind, blind faith and stubborn spirit to venture into the unknown.

programme.desc: Katie takes her best friend, Delaney, on a nostalgic trip to their childhood hometown to tell her she's getting married. Their journey soon takes some unexpected turns courtesy of a bizarre rental homeowner, a chance encounter with a former classmate, a bachelor party, and a few potential love interests.

programme.title: Epic
programme.desc: Mary Katherine (Amanda Seyfried), or M.K., is a headstrong, spirited teenager who has a strained relationship with her father (Jason Sudeikis). She loses patience with her dad's tales of unseen people who live in the woods, but when she is magically transported to that mythic realm, she gains new perspective. M.K. joins a race of beings known as the Leafmen in their battle to protect their queen (Beyoncé Knowles) from their enemies, evil Mandrake (Christoph Waltz) and his crew of Boggans.

programme.title: DC League of Super-Pets

However, when the Man of Steel and the rest of the Justice League are kidnapped, Krypto must convince a ragtag group of animals to master their own newfound powers for a rescue mission.

programme.title: The Meg

With time running out, a visionary oceanographer recruits rescue diver Jonas Taylor to save the crew and the sea itself from an unimaginable threat a 75-foot-long prehistoric shark known as the Megalodon.

When his second-in-command, Officer Dixon -- an immature mother's boy with a penchant for violence -- gets involved, the battle is only exacerbated.

As police investigate, Griffin concentrates on a prestigious film that might reinvigorate his career. But he soon learns that David's demise hasn't been forgotten by everyone in Hollywood.

After Henry gets caught in the middle of a robbery and is shot in the head, he wakes from a coma to find that he has amnesia and can't even remember how to do the simplest of tasks. As he recovers and relearns how to function, Henry reveals a much kinder and more thoughtful personality, much to the surprise of his family and friends.

Beth (Jennifer Aniston) wants commitment from Neil (Ben Affleck), who sees nothing wrong with the status quo. Gigi (Ginnifer Goodwin) is tired of waiting by the phone, while Mary (Drew Barrymore) has a slew of supportive male friends, none of whom are straight. Meanwhile, Janine has trust issues with her husband, who can't trust himself around Anna.

On his commute back home one night, Clark notices a stunning woman (Jennifer Lopez) in a dance studio and decides on a whim to join a class for ballroom dancing. While Clark finds a new spark in his life, his wife, Beverly (Susan Sarandon), grows suspicious of his frequent absences, since he decides to keep his dancing a secret.

programme.title: Almost Famous
programme.desc: Set in 1973, it chronicles the funny and often poignant coming of age of 15-year-old William, an unabashed music fan who is inspired by the seminal bands of the time. When his love of music lands him an assignment from Rolling Stone Magazine to interview the up-and-coming band Stillwater -- fronted by lead guitar Russell Hammond and lead singer Jeff Bebe, William embarks on an eye-opening journey with the band's tour, despite the objections of his protective mother.

programme.desc: When Viktor Navorski (Tom Hanks), an Eastern European tourist, arrives at JFK in New York, war breaks out in his country, and he finds himself caught up in international politics. Because of the war, the Department of Homeland Security won't let him enter or exit the United States. He's trapped at JFK -- indefinitely. While living at the airport, Viktor falls for a flight attendant (Catherine Zeta-Jones). She may have feelings for him too. But what good is love if Viktor can't leave the terminal?

Now, the most provocative, erotic and hysterical book on her bedside table is the one she's writing. With a taste for adventure, and an opinion on every subject - from exercise to men to food to sex and everything in between - she's turning the page on a whole new life.

programme.title: Bridget Jones: The Edge of Reason
programme.desc: The sequel to "Bridget Jones's Diary" finds Bridget (Renée Zellweger) working as a TV host and still dating barrister Mark (Colin Firth). But Bridget is jealous of the time Mark spends with a co-worker (Jacinda Barrett), and, despite a vacation meant to smooth things over, ends their relationship. On assignment in Thailand, she has a dalliance with her disreputable ex, Daniel (Hugh Grant), and is temporarily jailed on the false accusation of drug smuggling, before Mark comes to the rescue.

Feeling that she has everything under control, Jones decides to focus on her career as a top news producer. Suddenly, her love life comes back from the dead when she meets a dashing and handsome American named Jack (Patrick Dempsey). Things couldn't be better, until Bridget discovers that she is pregnant. Now, the befuddled mom-to-be must figure out if the proud papa is Mark or Jack.

With her sister, Claire (Hope Davis), urging Catherine to leave their family home, and an ambitious student (Jake Gyllenhaal) searching through her father's notes, Catherine struggles to keep her composure and her sanity in this drama adapted from the stage play by David Auburn.

Frank Beardsley (Dennis Quaid) decides to move his family of eight children back to his old hometown, he encounters handbag designer Helen North (Rene Russo), an old flame from high school. Immediately, sparks fly between the two, and marriage is proposed. But Frank isn't the only one with kids to worry about -- Helen has a total of 10. Right away, the children have no intention of playing nicely, and together they decide to sabotage their parents' relationship.

Years later, Roy ekes out a hardscrabble existence until he discovers Amish bowling phenom Ishmael (Randy Quaid). He moves into a new place, which happens to be near a college campus, and tries to get his life back together. Two of his best friends, Frank and Beanie, start hanging out at Mitch's house, eventually turning the place into a wild party pad, much to the ire of the college's dean, Gordon "Cheese" Pritchard.

programme.desc: Get into the Christmas spirit with two unforgettable winners; one shares their family traditions, while another celebrates the holidays at home and in Germany after their life-changing win; David gets festive with his family!

programme.title: Caribbean Life
programme.desc: Newlyweds leave their farm in Ontario, Canada, for a life of adventure on St. Maarten; she wants a move-in-ready condo with a large kitchen, but he's looking for a boat where he can spend his days on the water.

programme.title: Caribbean Life
programme.desc: After dating for a few months, a couple that met online and bonded over love of cocktails traveled to one of her favorite places, the island of St. John; he fell in love with the island, and now they're looking for a home on the beach.

programme.title: Caribbean Life
programme.desc: A California couple wants to trade Bay Area traffic jams for toes in the sand in St. Thomas; they hope to find a condo close to the beach with a fabulous view, but their ultimate dream is to be near a marina where they can enjoy a new boat.
